import json, urllib.request

def post(payload, raw=False):
    body = payload if isinstance(payload, (bytes, str)) else json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:5000/sentiment",
        data=body if isinstance(body, bytes) else body.encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, json.loads(e.read())

s, b = post({"text": "I love this movie, it was wonderful!"})
print("POSITIVE TEST:", s, b)
s, b = post({"text": "This is terrible and I hate it."})
print("NEGATIVE TEST:", s, b)
s, b = post({"bad": "no text"})
print("MISSING TEXT:", s, b)
s, b = post("not json")
print("BAD JSON:", s, b)
EOF
